data: What is the average sentence depth of the 977 CoNLL test sentences, and how is it presented in the figure?

Average Depth = (Sum of (Depth × Number of Sentences)) / Total Number of Sentences

Average Depth = (0 × 634 + 1 × 249 + 2 × 88 + 3 × 5) / 977
